mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad consumer demand weakness that precedes reduced corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for joint signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO below 100), manufacturing sector weakness signals potential economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 expands in the prior quarter, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL (yoy) exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for joint signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market slowdowns (HOUST below 1250 thousand units), weak housing activity signals reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is below 1250, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
